title: Average cost as seed expectation
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\\Omega$ be a finite input alphabet, let $\\alpha$ be an output set, and let $f:\\Omega^n\\to\\alpha$. For a finite randomized decision tree $T$ computing $f$ and any probability distribution $\\mu$ on the input space, the average query cost of $T$ under $\\mu$ equals the expectation, over the random seed of $T$, of the deterministic tree's average query cost under $\\mu$.
hypotheses_covered: $\\Omega$ is finite, so the input space is finite
$T$ is a randomized decision tree computing $f$
$\\mu$ is a probability mass function on the input space
